about: Every outside source in library/skills: repo, licence, pinned commit, which upstream folder became which local skill, and the replace rules bin/absorb.mjs re-applies on every pull. mode 'pull' = absorb.mjs can refresh it from upstream; 'frozen' = adapted by gigabrain (refresh means re-adapting by hand, so pull refuses without --force); 'vendored' = transformed by hand (see the skill's own note). Exclude lists name upstream files not copied.

skipped.banner-design, brand, design, design-sys: sibling skills in the same repo; not needed yet, pull one when a real task shows the gap

nextjs.clone_note: next.js is huge: the cache clone is shallow + sparse (`git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse`, then `sparse-checkout set skills`). Recreate it that way before absorb.mjs pull/diff if ~/.cache/nikabrain/upstream/nextjs is missing, or the helper does a full-history clone.
